A familiar idea.
Your own vocabulary.

          
These words control the language. Loop with for and in, branch with when, and return values easily.

          

            Instead of
            for fruit in basket
            You could write
            para fruta en canasta
          

          
Keywords are case-sensitive. Built-in helpers such as range(), push(), and len() keep their names.

          YOURS, ONLINE AND OFFLINE
          
From your browser
to your computer.

          
Everything you need to write and run Nova programs, packed into one ZIP.

          
          
No account or API key needed for the offline runner.

        

        
      

      

        

          

          EASIEST WAY
          
Double-click and run

          
    
            
  1. Download and extract the ZIP.
    2. 
            
  2. Open RUN.html in Chrome or Edge.
    3. 
            
  3. Edit your program and press Run.
    4. 
          

          
Works offline. No installation required.

        

        

          

          FOR YOUR TERMINAL
          
Run it from a command

          
With Node.js 18 or newer installed, open a terminal in the extracted folder:

          
node cli.cjs hello.nova

          
Your language definition and interpreter are included. The same programs work in both runners.

A small language with room for big ideas.

          
Numbers, text, booleans, lists, variables, conditions, for/repeat/while loops, functions, input, and built-in helpers. Examples below use your current keywords.

        

      

      

      

        
Good to know

        
Use # for comments. Indentation makes code readable; your end keyword closes blocks. Lists start at index 0. Keywords and variable names are case-sensitive. Each run starts fresh.

        
Programs run in an isolated worker with execution and output limits. This language has no file, network, or operating-system access. It is a portable interpreted language; the download includes the interpreter.
